title: Reference props
description: Reference material the user opens in one click: a `pointer` to a project file, which opens in the reading panel, or a web `url`, which opens in the user's browser, never both; and an optional `title` (FR-9). The contract's validation function checks that it holds exactly one of `pointer` and `url`, and that the URL is absolute, `http` or `https`, with a host and no user name or password (AD-8).
